method: canonical face RGB with preserved source alpha + authored/candidate poses + silhouette-constrained bidirectional DIS; targeted 48/32 uniform phases

processing.alphaCleanup: 8-connected components over alpha>32; retain components with area >= max(48, 0.001 * largest component), then dilate the retained mask by one pixel to preserve antialias fringe
processing.registration: one uniform scale to canonical eye distance; translate eye midpoint to the seat-to-lie endpoint x trajectory and alpha>160 foot baseline to y=372; premultiplied RGBA warpAffine; locally plant candidate feet to the shared mean of the 45% and 70% source paw centers
processing.face: apply stable_face after registration and to each interpolated lie pose with narrow central chin extension (24px half-width, feather 12px; through eyeY+90 then feather 24px); preserve target alpha and exact shared seat/original lie endpoint
processing.pawSupport: graft original lie endpoint paw pixels to keyframes 11 and 14 in two narrow masks (x half-width 28px + 8px feather; y starts at 330 + 8px feather); preserve keyframe 15 exactly, use direct source support over transitions 11-14 and 14-15, then restore the planted patch after face graft for phases >=11
